summary: Tested parts pagination feature (iter-3) on the PHP simbeng_v1 app. Added /app/backend/tests/test_parts_pagination.py with 10 pytest cases covering default per_page=50, page-2 navigation, per_page=100, invalid per_page (falls back to 50), invalid p (clamped to last page), prev disabled on page 1, next disabled on last page, page1/page2 row disjointness, integration with search q=OLI, and integration with filter=low. All 10 backend tests pass. Regression: existing 11 tests in test_simbeng_php.py still pass. Ran Playwright E2E: login -> parts page -> verified per-page selector options [25,50,100,200] with default 50, 50 rows on page 1, page-2 navigation shows rows 51-100, per_page auto-submit works on change (URL contains per_page=100), search q=OLI preserved in pagination links, edit action buttons still present. Info text uses proper Unicode endash U+2013 as rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: parts.php line 70 uses direct string interpolation for LIMIT/OFFSET ($per_page, $offset). Values are sanitized via int cast and in_array whitelist so it's safe here, but consider binding as int params for consistency.
parts.php has grown to 645 lines (mostly JS). Consider extracting the HSC search JS and import JS into separate assets/js files to keep the page file under 700 lines and improve maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None. DB has 610 parts from previous iterations (preserved per instructions).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pagination feature works end-to-end. Note: raw HTML source uses – entity between page numbers; browsers render as U+2013 endash. Any assertion on visible info text should either compare against U+2013 or html.unescape the source. DB currently has 610 parts. Preview URL: https://simbeng-stock-search.preview.emergentagent.com/
